source_claim: AlphaEvolve mutation responses may include natural-language explanation before SEARCH/REPLACE edit payloads while the edits remain structured diff blocks
claim_boundary: This boundary records that LibreEvolve manifests include runtime.history.natural_language_preamble_report for bounded, redacted leading explanatory text before the first structured mutation marker, with structured proposal metadata interop, diff/file/block leading-preamble support, status/mode counts, and rejection of prose between or after mutation sections. It does not claim configurable preamble policy controls, raw full-replacement preamble disambiguation, semantic rationale-quality scoring, cross-run preamble tables, preamble-to-proposal-memory joins, or arbitrary unparsed rationale acceptance.
